name: bar-reveal
description: Reveal the hidden bar while Super is held (QBAR-08). Explicit `release: false` — this entry claims the PRESS edge only. The RELEASE edge of the same chord is a separate, pre-existing Hyprland bind (tap Super -> main menu, keybinds.lua), and the two never collide because keybind-doctor's chord-collision check compares the edge, exactly as its shadow check always has.

name: notif-centre
description: Toggle the notification centre (Phase 19 Plan 06, D-19-16, QNOTIF-06) — repoints the outgoing daemon's own Super+N chord onto this shell's own GlobalShortcut.

name: power-menu
description: Toggle the in-process session/power dialog (Phase 20 Plan 06, QPOWER-01, D-20-22) — repoints wleave.sh's own Super+Shift+Q chord onto this shell's own GlobalShortcut.
